payload.name: Extract-each-enumerated-goal-or-preference
payload.description: When a speaker message lists multiple distinct durable goals, preferences, or plans in one utterance, extract each item as a separate candidate or include all items in one candidate's content instead of dropping the unmentioned portion while enriching an existing memory.
content: During extraction, when one message explicitly enumerates two or more distinct durable facts (goals, preferences, plans, aspirations), create one candidate per distinct fact or make sure every distinct fact appears in the candidate content; do not let the enrichment of an existing memory omit the other items.
Stop after capturing the distinct durable items: ignore evaluative filler, examples, or transient remarks that do not add a new durable fact.

solves: Construction extraction can silently drop distinct durable facts when a single utterance lists several goals or preferences and only the part related to an existing memory is captured. This Skill applies to future sessions where a speaker enumerates multiple distinct durable goals/preferences in one message and one segment matches an earlier memory; the extractor should preserve each distinct item. It must not be applied to messages containing a single fact, or to rhetorical/evaluative filler that the base extraction already ignores.
